messages.body_plain:
If you built the package from the source codes, there is a macro named "MAX_CHROMOSOME_NAME_LEN" defined in src/subread.h. The default value is 100.

You may change its value to suit your chromosome names, and recompile the package. It is suggested not to change it larger than 200.

messages.subject: Re: disable soft-clipping?
messages.body_plain:
Hi
What I want to achieve is to get all alignments of best alignment class (stratum) of full length reads [1] and that the maximum number of mismatches would be exactly defined. E. g. if 2 mismatches are allowed and the best alignment is with 2 mismatches, then I would like to get all alignment which have exactly 2 mismatches.

I see to two potential problems where softclipping can lead:
1)If I understand the softclipping and mismatches correctly then when mismatches are at the ends of the reads they are not counted. It can result that alignments having mismatch at the ends are reported while alignments with mismatches in the middle will not be reported (as in example):

Example:
read                  ACGTACGT
genomic loc1      tCGAACGT - reported as 1 mismatch (2nd is softclipped)
genomic loc2     ACGATCGT - not reported while has 2 mismatches
(Actually both have same number of mismatches and I would like both of them to be reported)

I am aligning PE reads which are corresponding to RNA fragments with length 18-300 bases.
If I think a bit more then for short reads (18-~30 bases) the alignments with mismatches in the middle can not be reported together with alignments of mismatches at ends. This is because the subreads (seeds) are about the size of the read and then majority (or all) of the seeds would not have match in hash table (index).
If I think even more then even for longer reads it will be a problem as the higher number of seeds will have a mismatch with the genomic location when the mismatches are in the middle of alignment compared when it is at the end of the alignment (resulting less votes).

Now if I understand correctly then the issue does arise from the concept of alignment used and there can not be much done about it?
I should try to figure out how much such reads would be there which align only with mismatches and could be influenced by the issue.

2)I want to allow maximum 2 mismatches.
If softclipping is allowed and mismatches in softclipped region are not counted then alignments reported can actually contain more than 2 mismatches in the full length region.

" The clipped bases cannot be mapped along with other bases in the read and they need to be marked. "

If I understand correctly then currently the non-end mismatches are not marked but mismatches can be marked using MD:Z: tag (at least Bowtie2 is doing so).

--
Hannes

messages.subject_clean: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
messages.body_plain:
Yes, it was because of the non-seekable file. FeatureCounts scans the annotations twice, and rewinds the file handler in between. If the file handler cannot be rewinded, featureCounts will wait forever in the second scan.

It is better not to scan it twice. We can change the program to remove the first scan.
